endorsements.quote: Ensuring safe and meaningful clinical deployment requires continuous post-deployment monitoring, rigorous external validation, improved interpretability, and the development of multimodal systems that integrate imaging with clinical and biological data.
Equally critical is clinician education to preserve human oversight and prevent overreliance on algorithmic output.

unlisted_practices: Conduct rigorous external validation of AI systems before clinical deployment.
Improve the interpretability of AI systems.
Develop multimodal AI systems that integrate imaging with clinical and biological data.

screen.reason: This is an editorial reviewing the limitations, error risks, and governance/deployment requirements (e.g., monitoring, external validation, clinician education) for AI in gastroenterology.
